text:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Spectra's product team flagged a new internal-tools squad looking to onboard next month. Use case: embeddings + realtime document summarization. They signaled ~2x overall QPS vs today and want data isolation.

Omar (Solutions): Good catch. Do we have concrete numbers (peak qps, avg tokens)? Any timeline from their PM?

Maya (CSM): From the kickoff call: peak ~50 QPS, avg ~15 QPS. Embeddings batch jobs ~200 reqs/min. Summaries are ~750–1k tokens per response on average. Tentative start target 2026-05-10. They mentioned internal-only docs (no PHI for now) but will confirm.

Priya (AE): Renewal with them is Sept — this looks like a classic expansion opportunity. If we can scope a clean pilot that shows cost vs Dedicated benefits, we should lock them into a reserved pilot. Can we get a quick cost-delta and pilot scope? Want to avoid surprise overages.

Kai (SRE): We can support this but recommend reserved capacity if they need consistent tail latency. Short-term mitigations: prefix/KV caching for repeated contexts and request-level rate limits. Long-term: Dedicated pool + VPC peering if they require isolation. Any cert/KMS needs known?

Jess (Onboard PM): I'll run our onboarding checklist. Need: Spectra IAM contact, sample payloads, sample embed batch shape, SLOs from their PM, and preferred timezones. Can we pencil an enablement session May 2 (PST)?

Maya (CSM): I'll ask for sample schema and an example S3 ingest bucket. I'll also confirm whether the docs contain any regulated data.

Omar (Solutions): For a fast, cost-conscious pilot I'd propose: model variant lla-mini-q8 for gen + batching=64, embeddings via batched requests. Quick CLI to reserve a pilot capacity for planning only:

```
rbw reserve --customer=spectra --gpus=2 --start=2026-05-01 --duration=30d
```

That gets us predictable throughput while we validate latency.

Kai (SRE): That CLI is fine as a placeholder but ops needs formal approval and an approved PO. I'll draft a Dedicated pilot proposal including throughput targets, fallback policies, and peering/KMS checklist.

Priya (AE): Success metrics I'd like captured: 95th tail latency < 300ms for embeddings, gen tail < 1s (95th), embedding throughput >= 800/sec for batched paths, and a clear cost-per-1M-token comparison hosted vs dedicated. Also want a locked pilot rate for the duration.

Jess (Onboard PM): Enablement deck items I can own: 1) SDK quickstart + sample code 2) batching & KV cache best practices 3) ingestion examples and S3 hooks 4) SLO definition and rollback plan. I'll draft slides and a short demo notebook.

Maya (CSM): Next steps: (1) Priya to confirm budget signal by 2026-04-15; (2) Kai + Omar to produce pilot plan + cost delta by 2026-04-22; (3) Jess to schedule enablement May 2 (PST). Tagging @Kai @Omar @Jess @Priya :thumbsup:

Kai (SRE): On it. I'll include certs, KMS notes, and network peering steps. Also recommending we apply a temporary rate-limit on their org key to protect noisy neighbor risk during initial ramp.

Omar (Solutions): I'll draft the model/quantization recommendation and include an estimate of token-level cost and Rack-level throughput. Will also add Console telemetry hooks for token-level cost and per-route latency so Priya can show value to the buyer.

Maya (CSM): I'll follow up with the Spectra PM for sample payloads and confirm no regulated data. Logging this as an account expansion signal and potential ARR uplift — updating CRM and flagging renewal play. Will post updates here after budget confirmation.

Priya (AE): Thanks team — please surface any blockers early. If pilot looks good we can move the renewal timeframe to discuss a Dedicated commitment.

Jess (Onboard PM): I'll create the calendar invite once Priya confirms budget window.

Maya (CSM): Awesome — closing loop after Spectra confirms sample payloads.
